task.title: Updating an immutability policy by using the Red Hat Quay API
task.shortdesc: To change the tag pattern or match rule of an existing policy, you can update an immutability policy for an organization or a repository in {product-title} by using the API. Send a PUT request with your bearer token and the policy UUID, and a JSON body with the new tag pattern and match rule.

ul.li: You have created an OAuth access token.
You have set FEATURE_IMMUTABLE_TAGS to True in your config.yaml file.
